texts.en:
Enormous sinkholes have appeared on the surface of [This.GetName], causing significant infrastructure damage. One of the fissures opened underneath the foundations of one of the planet's buildings, causing it to partially collapse. Fortunately, all affected areas were evacuated successfully.

We cannot determine the exact cause of the sudden appearance of these geological cavities, but additional maintenance checks have been implemented to monitor surface erosion.

summary.text:
# 巨大陷坑 / Massive Sinkholes

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud

## 如何开始 How it starts

迷信者（Superstitious Beliefs）文明的周期事件触发：每个13年周期开始（首个周期除外）掷出吉或凶（shroud.210/220/230 → 410/415，events/shroud_events.txt:961-1221），再从 on_action 的16个等权事件中抽取一个（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5749-5789）；本事件每个帝国至多一次（国家旗标 shroud_730_triggered）。凶兆事件。拥有符合条件的行星（sb_massive_sinkholes_planet_trigger）。分流 shroud.730 → 732。

Triggered by the cycles of a Superstitious Beliefs empire: each 13-year cycle (except the first) rolls good or bad luck (shroud.210/220/230 → 410/415, events/shroud_events.txt:961-1221) and one of the 16 equally weighted events of that on_action is drawn (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5749-5789); this event happens at most once per empire (country flag shroud_730_triggered). A bad luck event. Owns a planet satisfying sb_massive_sinkholes_planet_trigger. Router shroud.730 → 732.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单窗口通知，无后续剧情；唯一的选项直接生效。唯一选项：毁坏一座随机非首都建筑，并添加两个“深坑”障碍物（d_deep_sinkhole）。

A single notification window with no continuation; its only option applies directly. Only option: a random non-capital building is ruined and two d_deep_sinkhole blockers are added.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无分支；与同一抽取池中另外15个事件互不相关，各自独立成卡。

No branching; independent of the other 15 events of the same draw pool, each shown as its own card.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5749-5789`; `events/shroud_events.txt:645-760,961-1221`; `common/scripted_variables/09_scripted_variables_shroud.txt:43`; `events/shroud_events.txt:3076-3134`
- 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.
对照脚本核实了触发条件、旗标、选项效果和本地化；触发链（周期→吉凶掷骰→on_action）已核对。

Trigger, flag, option effects and localisation were checked against the script; the trigger chain (cycle → luck roll → on_action) was verified.
